notes:
Cao da site - Vionic day du bien the + Bang eBay + listing nhap

- Vionic: lay du tat ca mau, size (con/het), variant width, ma tran ton kho,
  Details, Fit & Care, anh fit guide va gallery ca 3 mau (30 anh). Doc thang
  jsonConfig nen khong phai cho trang render xong.
- Loc thong tin lien he: dong nao chua website/email/SDT bi xoa khoi mo ta.
- Nut "Bang eBay": bien tap tieu de/mo ta/gia goc/% gia list (mac dinh 7%),
  bo sung tay link anh con thieu, chinh variant va them dong tuy y,
  Note + Link web tuong tu.
- Convert anh -> CDN (mac dinh Lumi img.vgplay.vn): site chan hotlink thi tai
  anh qua tab trinh duyet dang mo. Xong tu luu bang tam tren Lumi.
- Nut "Tao listing nhap": sinh SKU theo cai dat, gia cai dat, variant chi to hop
  con hang, day len bang listing nhap de nhom /ebay dung tiep.
- Excel them cot: Mau, Size con/het, Variant, Ton kho theo mau, Details,
  Fit & Care, Anh fit guide.
